description: Source code for hostapd ucode integration, managing BSS and interface configurations, and communication with external ucode registry.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_bss_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieve or create a ucode resource value for a given hostapd_data instance.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_iface_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieve or create a ucode resource value for a given hostapd_iface instance.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_update_bss_list
methods.description: Update the list of BSS for a given interface in the ucode registry.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Update all interface data in the ucode global object.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_add_iface
methods.description: Add a new interface via ucode.

methods.name: bss_conf_find_vlan
methods.description: Find a VLAN configuration by ID within a BSS config.

methods.name: bss_conf_rename_vlan

methods.name: bss_reload_vlans

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_set_config
methods.description: Set BSS configuration from a file and index.

methods.name: hostapd_remove_iface_bss_conf

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_add_bss
methods.description: Add a BSS to an interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_set_bss_order
methods.description: Set the order of BSS instances within an interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_ctrl
methods.description: Send control commands to a BSS.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_switch_channel
